title.value: Adaptive patch foraging in deep reinforcement learning agents
title.justification: The paper primarily discusses the development and investigation of deep reinforcement learning agents in a patch foraging task, drawing comparisons with biological foragers.
title.quote: Here we investigate deep reinforcement learning agents in an ecological patch foraging task.

extractions.description: This paper explores the application of deep reinforcement learning in ecological patch foraging tasks. The authors demonstrate how AI agents can learn adaptive foraging patterns similar to biological organisms, approaching optimal foraging behavior described by the marginal value theorem. The study also investigates the internal dynamics of these agents, highlighting similarities with neural patterns observed in non-human primates.

climate_change_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on the behavior of artificial intelligence models in a foraging task, with no direct emphasis on climate change or related environmental applications.
climate_change_is_central.quote: Despite its importance to biological intelligence, patch foraging is understudied in artificial intelligence research.
